content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Tax, valuation and financial advisory for individuals and funds; does not manage REITs or real estate properties for fees."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced HR, payroll and workers' compensation for small businesses; unrelated to managing real estate companies."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, surveying and land planning consultancy for developers and agencies; project-based, not recurring management of REITs."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to tenants for rent; an asset owner rather than a fee-based manager of REITs."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and operations services for government and industrial clients; project-based, not REIT management."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Installs and maintains mechanical, electrical and plumbing building systems; technical trade services rather than property management for REITs."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical and electrical contracting and building systems installation; construction trade work, not management of REIT properties."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Site development, paving and civil construction performed under project contracts; a construction business, not property management."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions; a financial intermediary with no management of REITs or real estate."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Owns and operates a hotel and apartments, earning guest and tenant revenue; an asset owner rather than a manager paid by REITs."}]}
